sentences.en: Japanese Immigration Control is known for being strict with refugees.
sentences.zh: 日本移民局对难民的管理非常严格。

sentences.en: Illegal immigration is a serious threat to all civilized countries.
sentences.zh: 非法移民是所有文明国家的一大威胁。

sentences.en: Governments must find a solution to the illegal immigration crisis.
sentences.zh: 政府必须找到解决非法移民危机的办法。

senses.zh: —移民;移民入境;(总称) 外来的移民
